title: Velocity High Flyer Credit Card: 80k Velocity Pts + 100 Status Credits ($3.5k/month spend first 2 months), $349 AF @Virgin Money
body:
Deal: Velocity High Flyer Credit Card: 80k Velocity Pts + 100 Status Credits ($3.5k/month spend first 2 months), $349 AF @Virgin Money

[starburstyellow] PSA: You cannot apply for a supplementary card with virgin money for time being. I'm currently stuck with this situation as got approved last month after finding a new home for HSBC's exit come mid November.
Need to find a new card for me and the wife now.
[soan papdi] You can add the same card to two phones. Alternatively one of you uses the physical card and another uses it on the phone. Is there a specific need for an additional card?
[tkboi] I didn't get a extra card holder cos I refused to pay the $89 PA fee for it
so I just set up apple pay for the wife
[cook99] Same as other, add it to multiple wallets on phone, and give card to wife and just use phone wallet card for self.
[Buy2Much] …you now receive 100 Status Credits if you meet the minimum spend ($3,500 each month for the first 2 months)..
Not quite correct statement. It is:
Earn an additional 20% bonus Status Credits for Virgin flights paid for using the card (capped at 100 Status Credits per year)
[realaccount627465746] they're 2 separate things.
To be eligible for 100 Status Credits, you must meet the spend criteria to receive 80,000 bonus Velocity Points. 100 Status Credits will be credited to your Velocity Frequent Flyer account within 30 days of receiving the 80,000 bonus Velocity Points.
and
The Virgin Australia Velocity High Flyer Card Bonus Status Credits Benefit is a Special Feature available to Primary Cardholders only. An additional 20% Bonus Status Credits will be awarded when you fly on an Eligible Virgin Australia Flight and meet eligibility criteria being: a) a flight purchased using your Virgin Australia Velocity High Flyer Card directly with Virgin Australia (via Virgin Australia website, Virgin Australia Call Centre or Virgin Australia App); b) the Virgin Australia flight is eligible to earn Status Credits; c) your Velocity membership number was provided against the booking at the time of purchase or before your date of travel; d) at the time of booking, purchasing and taking the flight, your credit card account must be open and in good standing. The amount of Bonus Status Credits is capped at 100 Bonus Status Credits each credit card anniversary year.
[VerticallyIntegrated] Does Virgin offer rewards points for monthly spend that you can convert to e-gift cards?
[bez-54] I cancelled about 20 months ago and have just been provisionally approved (pending review of payslips) without issue.
